photos.file: Abbott's booby fledgling in bird nursery.jpg
photos.desc: This Abbott's booby fledgling was found on the ground after falling off the tree, most likely due to strong winds or a failed flying attempt. The National Park established a bird nursery and enlarged
Abbott's booby fledglings still get fed by their parents several months after being able to fly and stay in the same tree, mostly even on the same branch, where the nest was situated
